say:5:1710303003:1.text: Kara, tell me again—where and when did Countess Caloren vanish?
say:5:1710303003:1.source_cn: 卡拉，再说一遍！伯爵夫人是在哪里、什么时候消失的？

say:6:1710303004:1.text: F-Fifteen minutes ago, when the Countess was resting in her bedroom...
say:6:1710303004:1.source_cn: 就、就在一刻钟前！夫人在卧室休息……

say:7:1710303005:1.text: I went out to fetch a cup of tea, and by the time I returned, the Countess had disappeared...
say:7:1710303005:1.source_cn: 我只是去端了杯茶，回来人就不见了……

say:8:1710303006:1.text: The same thing happened to the Chief Justice! We were in our office in the upper district. One moment he was there, the next... he was gone!
say:8:1710303006:1.source_cn: 法官大人也是！我们都在上城区的办公室，他前一秒还在，下...

say:10:1710303007:1.text: Th-The chief editor went missing at our news agency!
say:10:1710303007:1.source_cn: 我、我们主编是在报社里失踪的！

say:12:1710303008:1.text: Captain, Magister Merlin and I also received a missing person report!
say:12:1710303008:1.source_cn: 报告队长！梅林阁下与我调查完毕，现在也有一宗失踪案报告！
say:12:1710303008:1.male: Captain, Magister Merlin and I also received a missing person report!
say:12:1710303008:1.female: Captain, Magister Merlin and I also received a missing person report!

say:14:1710303010:1.text: Viscount Urswick, the Deputy Minister of Internal Affairs.
say:14:1710303010:1.source_cn: 内务副大臣乌瑟斯子爵。

say:17:1710303012:1.text: I thought he was with you.
say:17:1710303012:1.source_cn: 司令……他没跟你们在一起吗？我以为你们正在一同调查圣古...

say:18:1710303013:1.text: We split up and agreed to meet here again before sunset.
say:18:1710303013:1.source_cn: 司令与我等分头调查，预定好日落时在驻地汇合。

say:19:1710303014:1.text: Since the Commander left the base, he hasn't returned or contacted us.
say:19:1710303014:1.source_cn: 但自从调查开始后，他一直没有回过驻地，也没有传回任何消息。

say:20:1710303015:1.text: Fa... The Commander's a man of his word. If he said he'd meet you, he wouldn't break his promise.
say:20:1710303015:1.source_cn: 父……司令是重诺之人，如果他约定好与你们见面，绝不会失约。

say:21:1710303016:1.text: Maybe something came up, and he had to take care of it?
say:21:1710303016:1.source_cn: 司令他……会不会是遇到了什么棘手的事情，耽搁了？

say:26:1710303019:1.text: This can't be a coincidence... These people must have something in common!
say:26:1710303019:1.source_cn: 这不是巧合……背后一定有着某种关联！

say:27:1710303020:1.text: Father didn't want me too involved in the investigation. All he told me was that he was heading to the upper district.
say:27:1710303020:1.source_cn: 父亲并不愿我过多插手圣古堂消失一案，只是离开前提到过要...

say:28:1710303021:1.text: I thought he was on his way to meet you, but now...
say:28:1710303021:1.source_cn: 我本以为是与你们一同汇合，现在看来……
say:28:1710303021:1.male: I thought he was on his way to meet you, but now...
say:28:1710303021:1.female: I thought he was on his way to meet you, but now...

say:30:1710303022:1.text: The upper district! The Chief Justice went missing there!
say:30:1710303022:1.source_cn: 上城区！法官大人就是在上城区失踪的！

say:31:1710303023:1.text: The Countess' residence... It's also in the upper district!
say:31:1710303023:1.source_cn: 伯爵府邸……也是在上城区啊！

say:33:1710303024:1.text: Um... our news agency isn't there.
say:33:1710303024:1.source_cn: 呃……我们报社倒不在那儿。

say:35:1710303025:1.text: Anyway, there must be a common thread between the cases. Father must have found something... I must find him at once!
say:35:1710303025:1.source_cn: 无论如何，这其中必有共通之处。父亲很可能查到了什么……...

choice_prompt:36:1710303025.text: Anyway, there must be a common thread between the cases. Father must have found something... I must find him at once!
choice_prompt:36:1710303025.source_cn: 无论如何，这其中必有共通之处。父亲很可能查到了什么……我必须立刻去找他！

say:39:1710303029:0.text: Captain, please allow me to come along!
say:39:1710303029:0.source_cn: 队长，请允许鄙人一同随行！

say:40:1710303030:0.text: No. I need you to stay here and escort all the complainants to the registry. Make sure you get the time and place of each disappearance!
say:40:1710303030:0.source_cn: 不，马丁！你留在驻地，把所有报案人带去登记室！详细记录...

say:41:1710303031:1.text: Let me know immediately if there are any new leads.
say:41:1710303031:1.source_cn: 一有新的线索，就及时通知我。

say:44:1710303027:0.source_cn: 多谢您的宽慰。我也相信父亲的身手。
